title: WINTERIZATION KIT - MAINTENANCE PRACTICES
question: What is the significance of installing the winterization kit, including coverplates, a placard, and breather line insulation, on 182S and 182T airplanes when operating in temperatures below 20 degrees F?
answer: The winterization kit consists of two coverplates  which attach to the air intakes in the cowling nosecap and a placard silk-screened on the instrument panel, and insulation for the engine crankcase breather line. This equipment should be installed for operations in temperatures consistently below 20 degrees F . Once installed, the engine crankcase breather insulation is approved for permanent use in both hot and cold weather.The winterization kit may be installed on 182S and 182T airplanes when temperatures are consistently below 20 degrees F . This procedure provides instructions for the installation and removal of the winterization kit and installation of the breather line insulation.

question: What is the detailed process for installing and securing the nose covers and nutplates during winterization cover installation?
answer: Winterization Cover Installation . (1) Position Nose Covers in the air intake openings of the nosecap and mark the positions of the Be sure existing holes on nose covers align with existing holes in nosecap. Using the newly made marks, drill holes through the nosecap. Remove engine cowling and upper and lower nosecaps from the aircraft. Using the nutplates as a template, mark and drill holes. Countersink holes on the forward side Install and secure nutplates on the aft side of the nosecap with rivets.Breather Line Insulation Installation. . Remove clamps from the breather line. Slip insulation tubes over breather line. Secure tube with a small amount of EC1300 cement  or equivalent in Ensure vent holes are not covered. If necessary, it is acceptable to trim the insulation.
